implementation.summary: Added the Crops section to MirrorPayloadTab.kt and fixed the plan's missing-bitmap defect by widening the tab signature with frame: ImageBitmap? as the second parameter, matching the widened MirrorHost content lambda's order. New private unregistered composables: PayloadCropsSection (CROPS label + right-aligned 'from frame {frameId}' using wave 1's bare counter; annotations.zip(windows).chunked(3) into weighted Rows with 8dp gaps and weighted Spacer fillers for a short last row — the Compose equivalent of the design's repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr))) and PayloadCropCell (72dp Box on Theme.color.stage, 6dp radius, ONE Canvas doing drawImage from window.srcOffset/srcSize into dstOffset=IntOffset.Zero/dstSize then stroking Theme.color.annotate at window.outlineRect — both read from the SAME CropWindow value, so image placement and outline cannot drift; caption '#{index} · {w}×{h}' interpolating core/annotation's TIMES directly). Crop windows built once in a keyed remember. Also extracted a shared private PayloadSectionLabel and moved T-7's PROMPT label onto it rather than duplicating the treatment.

issues: First run hit the known Kotlin/Native release-linker heap exhaustion (3x 'Java heap space' on linkReleaseFramework* under 4-way parallelism); passed unchanged on re-run. Orchestrator's own re-run also green.
grep -c sizeLabel on the file = 0, including KDoc — the caption divergence is explained as 'either module's size formatter' rather than naming it.

Orchestrator verified: no max, min, division or '* scale' anywhere in the file. The only operators are Dp->px unit conversion feeding cropWindow's own parameters, .toInt() narrowing at the drawImage call site, outlineWidth.toPx(), and a filler count.
Orchestrator verified drawImage and drawRect both read from the same `window` value inside one Canvas.
Only MirrorPayloadTab is public; PayloadSectionLabel, PayloadCropsSection, PayloadCropCell and all preview helpers are private and unregistered.

troubleshooting.issue: 3x 'e: Compilation failed: Java heap space' on linkReleaseFramework* tasks (4 GiB daemon heap).
troubleshooting.resolution: Known, already root-caused infra issue. Re-ran unchanged: green. Not chased with code.

troubleshooting.issue: REAL RENDERING BUG IN THE BRIEF, caught by the implementer. The backlog mandated remember(annotations, frozen.deviceSize) with cropWindow's boxW/boxH left at their design defaults (84f/72f). Those are DESIGN-SPACE units but a Canvas DrawScope works in PIXELS, so on a 2x display dstSize would max at 72px inside a 144px cell: the crop blits into the top-left quarter and outlineRect strokes at half scale.
troubleshooting.resolution: ORCHESTRATOR VERIFIED AND ACCEPTED the deviation. The cell size is converted to px via LocalDensity and passed as boxW/boxH, so every CropWindow value is already Canvas-space, and cellWidth/cellHeight joined the remember key set. Still computed once per freeze — never per recomposition, row or cell; the added keys are density-derived constants that change only when the window moves to another display. The cleaner long-term fix the implementer itself proposed is moving the Dp->px conversion into CropWindow.kt where that arithmetic belongs, but that edits T-4's shipped file and is outside T-8's scope. Stage 5 should treat the backlog's literal key list as superseded.

troubleshooting.issue: Wave 4 left no reusable header composable, so rendering CROPS the same way as PROMPT meant either duplicating the treatment or editing T-7's code.
troubleshooting.resolution: ACCEPTED: extracted a shared private PayloadSectionLabel and switched the PROMPT label onto it — a ~5 line edit inside PayloadPromptSection, within the one file T-8 owns. DRY within its own file, and it prevents two label treatments drifting. Flagged honestly by the implementer as outside a strict 'append a section' reading.

troubleshooting.issue: Cells are weighted (fillMaxWidth) while the crop is fitted to the design's 84x72 box, so on a panel wider than 296dp the blit sits top-left with slack on the right.
troubleshooting.resolution: That is what the mandated dstOffset = IntOffset.Zero implies. Centring would require the arithmetic TAC-4 forbids in the composable. Left as-is and recorded.

troubleshooting.issue: frame is nullable; what a cell renders without a bitmap had to be decided.
troubleshooting.resolution: The Canvas early-returns, leaving the flat Theme.color.stage box with its 6dp radius — and deliberately NOT the outline, since a lone annotate-coloured rect over an empty cell would read as a measured region of a frame that is not there. The caption still shows the real '#index · w×h' because that comes from reduced state, not the bitmap. frame is only dereferenced after the null check, so there is no crash path.

registryUpdates.change: props updated to 'state: MirrorUiState, frame: ImageBitmap?, hierarchy: HierarchySnapshotModel, onIntent: (MirrorIntent) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier' — frame added as the 2nd parameter to fix the plan defect. T-11's call site is MirrorPayloadTab(state, frame, hierarchy, onIntent). Section composables remain private and unregistered.
